hooks.command: PATH="$PATH:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin"; r=; for d in "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" "$(c=$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null) && dirname "$c")"; do if [ -n "$d" ] && [ -f "$d/.claude/hooks/run-guard.sh" ]; then r="$d/.claude/hooks/run-guard.sh"; break; fi; done; if [ -z "$r" ]; then r=$(git worktree list --porcelain 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/^worktree //p' | while IFS= read -r w; do if [ -f "$w/.claude/hooks/run-guard.sh" ]; then printf '%s' "$w/.claude/hooks/run-guard.sh"; break; fi; done); fi; if [ -n "$r" ]; then exec sh "$r"; else printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"The repo guard launcher (.claude/hooks/run-guard.sh) was not found in this checkout, CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, the main checkout or any worktree, so this call needs the developer to approve it."}}'; fi
